channels.title: Tenant channels
channels.description: Your personal conversations inside one tenant, read under the tenant you select.

tenant.label: Tenant
tenant.empty: You are not a member of any active tenant yet.

list.title: Your channels
list.description: The channels you own in this tenant, newest first. Select one to see its record.
list.empty: No channels in this tenant yet.

detail.title: Channel record
detail.description: What this deployment holds for the selected channel. Runs are read by run id under /runs/:id, and a channel record carries none, so this record is the whole state this page can honestly show.

selection.title: Company & team
selection.description: Choose the company and team you are working in. Only memberships you actually hold are listed, and nothing is chosen for you.

team.label: Team
team.none: You have not been added to a team in this company yet. Ask your company or team administrator to add you.

empty.title: No company membership yet
empty.description: You are not a member of any company on this deployment yet. Ask your company administrator to add you, then come back and choose where to work.

error.title: Your companies and teams could not be loaded.

revoked.title: Your access to that company or team has been revoked
revoked.description: The company or team you were working in no longer lists you as a member. Nothing was chosen for you — check again, or pick another company and team you belong to.
